title: Affine-chart colimit comparison preserves pointed evaluation
statement: Let Y be a scheme, Ω an algebraically closed field, i : Spec A → Y an open immersion, and xU : Spec Ω → Spec A a geometric point. Put p = xU(closedPoint Ω), F = κ(p), embed F into Ω by xU, and put K = separableClosure F Ω. For any colimit cocone c of the étale residue-triple ring diagram over A,p,K and any ring map ψ : c.pt → K agreeing on each coprojection with its specified triple residue map, there exists a ring-colimit isomorphism e : strictHenselizationRing (xU ≫ i) ≅ c.pt such that inclusion into Ω of ψ(e(a)) equals geometric evaluation of a for every a. No surjectivity of ψ is assumed or concluded. The notions are [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure], and [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation].

proof.text: Use the initial chart-neighbourhood inclusion and the pointed diagram isomorphism of etale_local_ring_triples. Compare its colimit with c using hc; compose with the small-model and ring-written affine-neighbourhood equivalences to obtain e. Mathlib colimitIso and coconePointUniqueUpToIso give the coprojection equations.

Construct the geometric-evaluation cocone on all affine pointed neighbourhoods. On chart-neighbourhoods, apply Spec.map injectivity and toSpecΓ naturality to the pointed equation of etale_local_ring_triples; hψ then identifies it with the transported triple map. Finality and IsColimit.hom_ext give equality on the full colimit, and the coprojection equations identify its pullback to the small model with the specified evaluation.

theorem strictHenselizationPointEvaluation_comparison
    {Y : Scheme.{v}} {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (A : CommRingCat.{v}) (i : Spec A ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (xU : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec A) :
    let p := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).1
    let F := (Spec A).residueField p
    let emb := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).2
    letI : Algebra F Ω := emb.hom.toAlgebra
    let K := separableClosure F Ω
    ∀ (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram A p K
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap F K)))) (_hc : IsColimit c)
      (ψ : c.pt →+* K),
      (∀ t, ψ.comp (c.ι.app t).hom =
        ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ).hom) →
      ∃ e : strictHenselizationRing (xU ≫ i) ≅ c.pt,
        ∀ a, (ψ (e.hom a) : Ω) = strictHenselizationPointEvaluation (xU ≫ i) a
